en: A colorized postcard view of a historic hilltop complex featuring the Albrechtsburg Castle and cathedral towers rising above the town of Meissen on the banks of the Elbe River. In the foreground is the river with a small sailboat; below the castle are clustered houses and riverside buildings with red-tiled roofs. The sky is light blue and the scene has a vintage, hand-tinted look. German captions are printed at the top: on the left identifying the town on the Elbe, and on the right naming the castle and cathedral.
